section_name: Foundational Literature on Systematic Offset and Residual Interpretation

candidates.title: The Examination and Analysis of Residuals
candidates.reason: Provides foundational pedagogical and mathematical principles for analyzing residuals, illustrating how inspecting residual patterns separates systematic model discrepancies and additive shifts from random noise.

candidates.title: A General Definition of Residuals
candidates.reason: Seminal methodological treatment establishing the formal role of residuals across statistical models to evaluate systematic structural deviations and mean departures.

candidates.title: Graphs in Statistical Analysis
candidates.reason: A classic pedagogical paper demonstrating how identical aggregate fit statistics can mask systematic prediction offsets, supporting the educational rationale for residual evaluation.

candidates.title: Cross-Validatory Choice and Assessment of Statistical Predictions
candidates.reason: Foundational work on prediction assessment clarifying the boundary between evaluating fixed-sample residual properties and measuring out-of-sample prediction performance.

candidates.title: Science and Statistics
candidates.reason: Foundational essay on model criticism that establishes the conceptual necessity of inspecting residual errors to detect systematic model offsets and inform corrective adjustments.

candidates.title: Regression Diagnostics: Identifying Influential Data and Sources of Collinearity
candidates.reason: Standard reference detailing diagnostic principles for linear regression, showing how residual analysis isolates constant model offsets and specification biases.

candidates.title: On the Validation of Models
candidates.reason: Methodological foundation explicitly decomposing mean squared error into systematic and unsystematic components, formalizing the role of mean additive offsets in prediction evaluation.

candidates.title: Residuals and Influence in Regression
candidates.reason: Comprehensive foundational text on regression diagnostics that establishes how systematic offset and intercept discrepancies manifest in residual analysis.

candidates.title: Statistics for the Evaluation and Comparison of Models
candidates.reason: Influential survey formalizing quantitative error partitioning, showing how systematic error components capture fixed prediction biases separately from residual dispersion.

candidates.title: Generalized Additive Models
candidates.reason: Foundational work in additive modeling providing theoretical grounding for decomposing predictors into structural additive terms and residual components.

candidates.title: How Biased Is the Apparent Error Rate of a Prediction Rule?
candidates.reason: Demonstrates why apparent same-sample residual calculations reflect finite in-sample fitting rather than generalizable out-of-sample error reductions.

candidates.title: A General Framework for Forecast Verification
candidates.reason: Foundational conceptual framework decomposing prediction quality into systematic calibration offsets versus random uncertainty, justifying educational motivation for offset correction.

candidates.title: Skill Scores Based on the Mean Square Error and Their Relationships to the Correlation Coefficient
candidates.reason: Seminal decomposition of mean squared error isolating unconditional bias (systematic mean error / additive offset) from correlation and unsystematic variation.

candidates.title: Neural Networks and the Bias/Variance Dilemma
candidates.reason: Landmark foundational review formalizing the bias-variance decomposition of prediction error, supporting the conceptual distinction between systematic bias offsets and residual variance.
